subject: QA PASS: canvas keyboard nav (WCAG 2.1.1) -- design verified
body:
Canvas keyboard nav QA: PASS

Verified in exam.html:
- tabindex='0' + role='application' on canvas: CORRECT (line 497)
- aria-label contains instructions: CORRECT ('Arrow keys move cursor. Enter to place point. Delete to remove.')
- aria-live polite region: CORRECT (line 767)
- Announcement strings: PASS -- 'Point placed at (2, 3). 5 points total.' -- no quotes or apostrophes that could break HTML attributes (Section 16c compliant)
- Shift+Arrow for 0.25 precision: NICE bonus, not in spec but good for math accuracy
- Asymptote mode works via keyboard (Enter while in VA/HA mode): CORRECT
- Delete/Backspace removes last point with announcement: CORRECT

One enhancement for future: when the keyboard cursor first appears (canvas receives focus), announce its starting position. Currently no announcement on focus -- screen reader user knows the keys but not where they are starting. Low priority, not a blocker.

WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard): This implementation satisfies the criterion for canvas graph interaction. Closing this spec from the backlog.
